title: Feature request - Add Basal input and tracking
symptom: User asks for a second type of insulin input so that basal insulin could be entered, tracked, and graphed. Many commenters second the request, particularly for MDI users of long-acting insulins such as Lantus or Levemir, and ask for configurable onset delay and duration.
cause: xDrip at the time lacked a basal insulin entry and tracking option, so users could not record or graph basal doses in the app.
fix: The capability to enter basal insulin now exists in xDrip, as stated when the issue was closed. PR #1388 was noted as adding more insulin types including basal insulins; visualization of basal insulin was intentionally not included to avoid changing business logic.
evidence_quote: This issue, based on its title, was about adding the ability to enter basal insulin.  That capability already exists now.  Hence, I am closing this issue.
